title: Audit the live browser flow and deploy the repaired workspace
description: Observe actual browser startup, graphics, Python execution and commands rather than treating a successful compile as proof. Deploy the integrated repair through the project commands and keep Beads current.
close_reason: Deployed version 29e04082-23ea-476d-a0b4-464207f982a4 to the configured Cloudflare account. Actual hosted Chrome run passed 3D startup, private-room auth, HTTP and WebSocket command routing, persistence, and the complete Python approach to 49.99 m at 165.15 simulated seconds with no console or network errors. Local blocked-download and 320px checks passed.

comments.author: koalazub
comments.text: Actual Chrome inspection reproduced the original B0001 crash and a second indexed-mesh normal panic. Fixed renderer initialization, disjoint queries, mesh normals and truthful readiness. Browser now draws frames; native step-input validation and remaining physics/UI contracts are being corrected before deployment.

comments.author: koalazub
comments.text: Local Chrome flow now passes a complete sensor-guided approach, 320px reflow/step and blocked-runtime recovery. Actual local Wrangler room verification passed 401/200 auth checks, HTTP observe/step, a second WebSocket viewer receiving a 322386-byte result and persisted 363642-byte state. Fixed exact-float JSON restore and decimal-string RNG handoff. Production deployment is in progress.

title: Remove decorative UI and make loading and controls explicit
description: Apply the provided Apple HIG design principles to a neutral analysis workspace. Prioritize the 3D view, Python controls, telemetry and visible download/initialization progress. Make Run do what its label promises.
close_reason: Neutral simulation-first UI, real WASM and Python byte progress, failure recovery and disabled prerequisites are integrated. Actual Chrome Python run reached the 50 m arrival radius at 165.15 simulated seconds with telemetry, trails, output and 167 flight samples. Fixed borrowed-PyProxy destruction; no console or network errors remained.

title: Render Phobos, ships and asteroids reliably in Bevy
description: Render the actual physics state with a recognizable Phobos body, spacecraft, asteroids and useful position/trajectory cues. Fix Bevy startup and report renderer readiness only after successful initialization.
close_reason: Observed Phobos overview and close spacecraft/debris views in Chrome with 502 mission entities and six compiled graphics pipelines. Fixed disjoint queries, indexed-mesh normal panic, missing gizmo renderer, startup failure reporting and seed-dependent mesh reconciliation.

title: Build the Phobos spacecraft and asteroid physics model
description: Replace the rover-only world with spacecraft, asteroids, Phobos gravity and real collision/thrust dynamics. Keep a fixed-step browser API and explicit reference frame and units; do not invent official scoring.
close_reason: Integrated real Rapier rigid bodies, CCD, shared terrain colliders, bounded substeps, body-frame acceleration, Phobos and approximate Mars differential gravity, seeded debris and sensor-limited radar. Actual Chrome Step advances time and poses; model and scoring limitations are explicit.

title: Establish the Escape from Phobos competition requirements
description: Re-read official Space Teams PRO competition information, sensors, scoring, APIs and starter repositories. Identify the intended Phobos spacecraft/asteroid mission and source every confirmed rule; do not assume the old Lunar SAR mission.
close_reason: Verified official STU4 controller, wiki, systems and sim config at c1e3fc8. Established API units, frames, sensors, scoring and numeric mission settings; recorded geometry and damage-model limits.

title: Build the competitive Phobos workspace and repair browser execution
description: The user requires a working Phobos scene with spacecraft, asteroids and actual physics, not the earlier rover-only model. Research the intended Space Teams PRO competition, implement the correct Bevy simulation, remove decorative theming, show real download/startup progress and verify the actual browser Run workflow before deployment.
close_reason: Delivered and browser-verified the Phobos spacecraft/debris practice workspace, real Rapier physics, sensor-limited Python control, stripped-down analysis UI, truthful download and failure states, collaboration and deployment. Official mission research is reflected in parameters; terrain, fuel, impact damage and camera limitations are explicit.

title: Pin the latest security-patched Node.js
description: Use official Node.js 26.12.1, the latest security release, in the shared Nix/devenv environment and both Cloudflare CLI wrappers. Keep the version and hashes reproducible across supported systems; do not install a global toolchain.
close_reason: Official security-patched Node.js 26.12.1 is pinned by verified archive hashes and used by the shared environment and CLI wrappers.

title: Connect the NotebookLM team entry links
description: Provide room sharing and a configurable link to the team NotebookLM workspace. Do not invent an unsupported NotebookLM code-execution API or replace it with JupyterLab.

notes:
The Fenix toolchain and real Bevy WASM are built. Combining the browser Python workspace, private collaborative rooms and static assets for the account deployment.
The user reauthorized both cf and Wrangler to account e74cdc2ff8fdb3053c6ab91be7524909. The project now targets this matching account; the earlier deployment is left untouched. Standard make/npm commands now encapsulate login, account alignment, build and deploy.

title: Add private collaborative rooms and browser command routing
description: Use authenticated room capabilities and Durable Objects for shared editing, browser host ownership, command acknowledgements and state updates. Keep simulation and user Python execution in browsers, not in the Worker.
close_reason: Deployed authenticated private rooms, persistent Yjs collaboration, shared state and HTTP/WebSocket browser command routing.

title: Build shared Python controls and live browser workspace
description: Provide the hosted simulation view, Python strategy editor, live telemetry, controls and run export. Execute Python in the browser and bridge API calls to the WASM simulation. Shared code and room links stay connected to the NotebookLM team workflow.
notes: Browser Bevy initialization, Python bridge imports, command acknowledgements, shared-state feedback, host restoration and room switching are integrated. NotebookLM links persist in the shared room and browser settings. Final deployment uses the encapsulated make deploy command.
close_reason: Built and deployed the browser Python workspace with Bevy commands, live controls, shared editing, host handoff and strategy/result export.

title: Build the Bevy WASM simulation and command API
description: Implement the browser-rendered rover practice world and a JSON command/state interface for reset, movement, attributes, observation and fixed-time stepping. Build real Bevy WASM, not a placeholder renderer.
close_reason: Actual Bevy Rust/WASM browser engine and command API compiled successfully into the Worker asset directory.

title: Pin Fenix Rust and browser WASM build tools
description: Provide a locked Fenix toolchain with the browser WASM target through devenv and flake. Do not use rustup or global Rust installs. Include matching WASM bindings and a repeatable build command.
close_reason: Pinned Fenix Rust and browser WASM target are available through the shared Nix environment, with a repeatable build script.

title: Cloudflare CLI and Worker foundation
description: Install the official cf CLI and Wrangler in the shared Nix environment and create the account-connected Worker.
close_reason: Both CLIs installed; western-sydney-orbital-api is deployed using the existing Wrangler account authorization.

title: Deliver the browser-based collaborative Bevy simulation
description: NotebookLM is the Google-linked team hub. Teammates open the hosted browser workspace, edit shared Python strategies and control a Bevy WASM simulation without native installs. Cloudflare hosts the application and shared-session bridge. Use Fenix-pinned toolchains and Beads for progress. No added testing or benchmark work.
close_reason: Delivered the hosted Bevy WASM workspace with browser Python API controls, private shared rooms, NotebookLM links, Fenix builds, patched Node.js and matched Cloudflare logins.
